fields.description: Denormalised from parent_snapshot.snapshot_date for query speed.
fields.label: Snapshot Date

fields.description: Denormalised from Account.account_type at snapshot time.
fields.label: Account Type

fields.description: Denormalised from Account.root_type at snapshot time. One of: Asset / Liability / Equity / Income / Expense.
fields.label: Root Type

fields.description: Closing balance at snapshot_date as raw debit minus credit. UI flips sign for Liability / Equity / Income based on root_type. Invariant: balance = debit_total - credit_total.
fields.label: Balance (Dr - Cr)

fields.description: Lifetime cumulative debits posted up to snapshot_date. For period totals, subtract another snapshot's debit_total.
fields.label: Debit Total

fields.description: Lifetime cumulative credits posted up to snapshot_date. For period totals, subtract another snapshot's credit_total.
fields.label: Credit Total
